name: Air Quality
description: The air you breathe now: a coloured AQI ring, PM2.5, PM10, ozone and NO2, a 2-day chart and the best hours to run or air the house.
prompt: An air quality app using the free Open-Meteo air quality API with no key, with my location or a searched city. Show the European AQI as a big coloured ring with a word like good or poor, the main pollutants PM2.5, PM10, ozone and nitrogen dioxide with small bars, an hourly AQI chart for the next 2 days, the best hours to go running or open the windows, and health advice for each level. Save favourite cities.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: El aire que respiras ahora: un anillo de color con el índice de calidad, PM2.5, PM10, ozono y NO2, un gráfico de 2 días y las mejores horas para correr o ventilar la casa.
